scope: Independent complete source and admission review. The reviewer ran only the previously recorded fully mocked tests and read-only file/hash checks; no native worker, process API probe, WSL, model or GPU execution.

resolved_findings.finding: Cached PID identity must not claim authentication of a newly opened or failed process handle.
resolved_findings.resolution: Historical and current-handle identity fields are separate; mocked negative regression passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Extra native calls before outer Job attachment widen the existing venv-launcher containment window.
resolved_findings.resolution: Popen is followed immediately by original Job attachment. Before GO, actual script runtime PID from its ready file must be enumerated and authenticated by held-handle membership, creation time and advisory exit-status observation in the outer Job. A missing or escaped actual runtime blocks GO.

resolved_findings.finding: Trace fsync before target event.set allowed pre-cancellation samples inside the claimed cancellation interval.
resolved_findings.resolution: Target event is set before the interval timestamp and trace I/O. During-cancel evidence is filtered between that conservative start and the target wrapper completion timestamp; at least one sample is mandatory. A distinct fresh post-target sample must precede sentinel release.

reviewed_controls: Fresh exclusive cpu-once directory reserves the sole attempt; no retry loop or alternate scenario exists.
The only worker commands are the unchanged stdlib Windows fixture in wait and sentinel modes. The harness has no WSL or StageOrchestrator dispatch branch.
Exact source pins and the original API interpreter hash are checked before reservation and again by the worker; final checks retain changes as blocked.
Actual worker runtime Job ownership is admitted before GO; target and sentinel have distinct private Job owner identifiers and context-bound readiness.
Target cancellation may qualify only with a naturally settled cancelled receipt and no diagnostic error. Sentinel release is forbidden after a failed target.
Independent sentinel evidence is required before, during and after target cancellation, followed by natural succeeded settlement.
Cleanup first requests owned cooperative cancellation; any forced outer Job cleanup or unverified final active count blocks qualification.
Full native error provenance and original versus cleanup errors remain private. Source-safe reports must retain uncertainty.
interpretation_limits: The OpenProcess boundary deliberately fails closed for all errors; prior code skipped failures. A newly exposed failed open, even code5, cannot itself identify the prior surfaced PermissionError cause.
GetExitCodeProcess status259 is advisory; it does not by itself prove continued liveness or ownership.
Added calls and tracing may alter timing. A clean sole pair does not explain or repair the original failure.
Any code other than5, missing native error, failed diagnostic probe or unproven identity must retain its exact unknown or blocked meaning.
Native behavior remains unqualified until the root's separately user-authorized sole execution and independent saved-data review.
launch_authority: The human user's existing one-pair CPU diagnostic authorization, exercised exclusively by the root after static preflight. This review grants no additional run or scope.
